sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Only [Frieren's Apprentice] Fern can be used as Unlocking Potential material
